role.title: Data Engineer
role.focus: Reliable data ingestion, transformation, storage, orchestration and analytics infrastructure
role.objective: Build, ship, test and maintain reliable production-grade systems in this specialization.

responsibilities.1: Design and implement reliable data ingestion, transformation, storage, orchestration and analytics infrastructure.
responsibilities.2: Translate requirements into maintainable technical solutions.
responsibilities.3: Write clean, modular and testable code.
responsibilities.4: Work with databases, APIs and production infrastructure relevant to the role.
responsibilities.5: Debug failures using logs, metrics and systematic root-cause analysis.
responsibilities.6: Use Git and collaborative development practices.
responsibilities.7: Automate repetitive engineering and deployment workflows.
responsibilities.8: Apply security, reliability and performance best practices.
responsibilities.9: Document architecture, decisions and operational procedures.
responsibilities.10: Deploy solutions and monitor them in realistic environments.
responsibilities.11: Measure quality and improve systems based on evidence.
responsibilities.12: Collaborate with engineers, product stakeholders and data teams.

qualifications.education: Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI/ML, Data or related field; strong equivalent self-learning is acceptable.
qualifications.experience: Projects, internships, open-source contributions or practical engineering work.
qualifications.portfolio: At least 2 substantial projects with documented technical decisions and a deployed or reproducible implementation.

1.name: Modern Analytics Data Platform
1.description: Build an end-to-end platform ingesting transactional data into object storage, transforming it with Python/Spark, loading analytical tables and serving BI queries.

2.name: Real-Time Event Pipeline
2.description: Build a streaming pipeline that consumes application events, validates schemas, aggregates metrics and writes analytics-ready data with monitoring.

3.name: Data Quality and Lineage Platform
3.description: Build automated checks for freshness, completeness, uniqueness and schema changes, with lineage metadata and failure alerts.
